title: Fractions
info: A fraction is part of a whole. The top number is the numerator. The bottom number is the denominator.
1/2 means one of two equal parts.

questions.q: In 3/4, which number is the numerator?
questions.explain: The numerator is the top number.
2/4 is two parts out of four, which is the same as one half.
When the top number is 1, a smaller bottom number means a bigger piece.
